notes.title: Patch 1.05.1
notes.content:
Just a small patch fixing some recently found bugs:

- Fixed bug in Tutorial where player could walk through brick wall.
- Fixed bug in Tutorial where cup would not delete when placed in garbage bin (thank you to Siles for reporting the bug!)
- Fixed bug in Disorientation where player could walk through certain trees (thank you to Siles for reporting the bug!)

notes.title: Distant 1.05 is live! (+ a new hidden achievement)
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This is the first update in a long time, and I'm happy to share with you all the many new changes!

Bug fixes:
- Fixed bug where TV in Paranoia could be turned on at end of level (user-reported bug! thank you!)
- Fixed bug where some buttons would not work in the main menu and pause menu for users with certain resolutions (user-reported bug! thank you!)
- Fixed bug where highlighting the volume slider in pause menu would highlight the Main Menu button.

Changes:
- Settings removed from Main Menu (for now)
- Disorientation level has been optimized, so this will [b]hopefully[/b] result in less crashes for many players.

Additions:
- A new hidden achievement!
- Added Credits to the Main Menu (Credits button should work now!)
